# Documentation conventions (`doc/`)

`doc/` is the user-facing reference. The docs site publishes it verbatim at each release tag and an agent reads one page at a time, so every page stands alone.

## File shape

```markdown
# Rails

One-sentence lead: what the page is.

- [Quick Reference](#quick-reference)
- [Related Documentation](#related-documentation)

<a name="quick-reference"></a>
## Quick Reference
<a name="related-documentation"></a>
## Related Documentation
- [Drivers](./drivers.md): which build resolves which rail.
```

## Rules

- One `#` per file and it is the first line, with a one-sentence lead right after it: the site copies it as the page description in its generated `llms.txt`. Never skip heading levels.
- Layout is `doc/<section>/<page>.md`, lowercase `[a-z0-9-]`: sections `getting-started`, `basics`, `architecture`. No `doc/index.md`.
- Put `<a name="kebab-slug"></a>` immediately before every `##` and list the slug in the ToC under the lead.
- A `basics/` page carries a Gotchas table (Mistake, Fix) of 3 to 6 rows, each verified in `lib/`.
- Samples use `dart` and `bash` fences, and every symbol in one exists in `lib/`. Commands are `dart run magic:dowel payments:<command>`. Tables are left-aligned (`:-----`) with identifiers in backticks.
- Links are relative `.md` paths inside `doc/` only; another plugin is linked by its `https://anilcancakir.com/magic/docs/<slug>/...` URL and core by `https://anilcancakir.com/magic/docs/...`.
- No dashes (U+2014, U+2013), no counts, no release-status wording, and no claim that this package calls Stripe: the web rail talks to your backend.

## Surface to page

| Change in | Update |
|:----------|:-------|
| `lib/src/contracts/`, `models/`, `enums/` | `basics/rails.md` |
| `lib/src/drivers/`, `support/` | `basics/drivers.md`, `basics/rails.md` |
| `lib/src/payments_manager.dart`, `facades/`, `providers/` | `architecture/*.md` |
| `lib/src/cli/`, `install.yaml` | `basics/cli.md`, `getting-started/installation.md` |
| `assets/stubs/` | `getting-started/configuration.md` |
